issues.action: Good sentence changed to 週末は掃除と洗濯をします; note now offers a noun list, たり or the て-form.

issues.problem: to-quote mistake: note said the verb before と思う is plain, but the good sentence uses volitional 行こう without explaining the change in meaning.
issues.action: Note extended: volitional 行こう gives 'I'm thinking of going'.

issues.problem: to-reciprocal explain and the に contrast said only two verbs (似ている, 比べる) accept に, which is too strong (会う, 相談する also take に).
issues.action: Reworded to 'a few verbs ... notably' and stated that 結婚する, けんかする, 同じ, 違う take only と.
